retrievalProfile.description: A vertically stacked minimalist layout featuring heavy slab-serif typography and a central abstract graphic composed of horizontal ink-like strokes.
triggerTerms: centered vertical layout with thin dividers
excludeWhen: asymmetric or chaotic layouts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, white-background composition with navy blue elements. It features a top-aligned band name in two distinct weights, a central column of abstract, wavy horizontal lines representing water, and a bottom-aligned title in a heavy slab-serif font with a decorative wave symbol.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry along the central axis
Contrast between ultra-condensed and ultra-wide typography
Balance between rigid geometric text and organic abstract lines
Framing provided by thin horizontal divider lines
coreInvariants: High-contrast navy blue on off-white background
Central abstract graphic composed of fragmented horizontal strokes
Thin horizontal rule lines separating text blocks from the center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The abstract graphic is centered and occupies the middle third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The heavy slab-serif title at the bottom acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-to-bottom vertical scan, starting with the condensed header, moving through the abstract center, and resting on the heavy footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the left and right margins emphasizes the vertical column.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background for clarity and space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue for all primary graphic and typographic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Thin tan or copper horizontal divider lines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low saturation, creating a professional and classic look.

letterConstructionRules: Top line: Ultra-wide, heavy slab serif with minimal x-height.
Second line: Ultra-condensed, tall sans-serif with thick vertical strokes.
Bottom line: Heavy, blocky slab serif with rounded terminals on specific characters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' in the bottom title is reduced in scale and underlined with two wavy lines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: pairing ultra-condensed verticality with ultra-expanded horizontality.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif weight of the bottom title.
Approximates the ultra-condensed verticality of the secondary header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a clean off-white canvas with a central vertical column of abstract navy blue horizontal ink strokes and two thin copper horizontal lines above and below the strokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add navy blue text: an expanded slab serif at the very top, a condensed sans-serif directly below it, and a heavy slab serif at the bottom with a small 'O' and wavy underline.

verificationChecks: Is the layout perfectly centered vertically?
Are the divider lines thin and copper-toned?
Is the navy blue consistent across all elements?
Does the bottom text feature the modified 'O'?

adjustableVariables: Density of the central abstract strokes
Weight of the slab serif fonts
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific band names or copyrighted logos
Ensure the 'O' modification is a generic wave rather than a specific brand mark

avoid: Blurry or feathered edges on the abstract graphic

postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical alignment of all elements
Verify the presence of the thin horizontal rules
Ensure the background is a solid, non-textured off-white
Confirm the abstract graphic remains centered
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Stack = [Expanded Slab Header] + [Condensed Sub-header] + [Thin Rule] + [Abstract Graphic] + [Thin Rule] + [Heavy Slab Footer with Modified Vowel]
